why: Print shops handle job tickets, paper stock and unit pricing (per page, per poster, per banner). The key is job tracking, paper inventory and proofing.
operator: The print shop manager handles job tickets, paper stock and client proofs. Their day is job intake, paper tracking and proof approval.
entities: Shop (id, nameAr, nameEn, branchId, address, phone, currency, taxRegistration, openingHours)

JobTicket (id, shopId, clientName, clientPhone, jobType (poster/banner/flyer/invitation), dimensions (w,h), unitPricePiasters, copies, totalPiasters, depositPiasters, balancePiasters, status (pending/proofing/printing/done), notes, readyDate)
PaperStock (id, shopId, name, sizeAr, sizeEn, weightPiasters per sheet, sheetQty, minThreshold, status, locationShelf)
Proof (id, jobTicketId, clientName, clientProofPDFUrl, status (pending/approved/rejected), approvedBy, approvedAt, notes)
Supplier (id, nameAr, phone, paymentTerms, visitDays, leadTimeDays)
PurchaseOrder (id, supplierId, status, lines, expectedAt, totalPiasters)
Staff (id, shopId, name, phone, role, hourlyRatePiasters, status)
batches: No : print shop carries no stock or expiry
expiry: Not applicable. Job tickets have status and ready date, paper has threshold not expiry
special: The core structures are the job ticket with its lifecycle (pending→proofing→printing→done), the paper stock with threshold tracking and the proof approval loop. Unit pricing per page/poster/banner is the key differentiator.
screens: Job ticket list: all tickets with type, client, dimensions, copies, total, deposit, balance, status, ready date
Job ticket detail: full info, dimensions, proof status, paper requirements, notes, ready date
Paper stock level: sheets in stock, minimum threshold, low-stock alert, reorder suggestion
Proof manager: upload client proof PDF, status (pending/approved/rejected), approve/reject, add notes
Proof gallery: view all proofs per job, approve/reject per proof
Purchase order: receive from supplier, update paper stock, record cost
Cash register: scan job ticket reference, record payment, print receipt with job details
Staff shift: clock in/out, job load per hour, notes
roles: Owner: everything : job tickets, paper stock, proofs, reports, billing
Print operator: create job tickets, upload proofs, mark status (pending/proofing/printing/done)
Proof approver: review client proofs, approve/reject, add notes
Stock clerk: receive paper shipments, update stock levels, reorder
reports: Job ticket volume per period: tickets created, proofing, printing, done per month
Proof approval rate: approved vs rejected per period, reasons for rejection
Paper stock turnover: sheets per period, low-stock alerts per period, reorder frequency
Revenue per job type: posters vs banners vs flyers vs invitations, revenue per type per period
Job turnaround time: from creation to done, average days per job type
integrations: Esc/POS thermal printer for receipts and proofs
WhatsApp deep link for client proof approval and ready-notice
Email for proof delivery and updates (opt-in)
File storage for proof PDFs (Firebase Cloud Storage)
onboarding: Shop basics: name, branch, address, phone, currency, working hours
Initial job types: the starting job types (poster/banner/flyer/invitation) with unit pricing per page/poster/banner
Paper stock: the initial paper list with size, weight and minimum threshold
Staff: add the initial team with their role templates
First week plan: create first job ticket, receive first paper shipment, first proof upload
seed: No sector-specific seed data. The engine provides the job ticket lifecycle and role templates.

tasks.title: Add job ticket list and detail screen
tasks.brief: Build the job ticket screen: list all tickets with type, client, dimensions, copies, total, deposit, balance, status, ready date. Done when the ticket list loads and the detail screen shows full ticket info.
tasks.done: When job ticket list and detail screen works and displays live data

tasks.title: Add paper stock level screen
tasks.brief: Build the paper stock screen: sheets in stock, minimum threshold, low-stock alert, reorder suggestion. Done when the stock level saves and low-stock alert triggers correctly.
tasks.done: When paper stock level works and alerts trigger correctly

tasks.title: Add proof manager with upload and status
tasks.brief: Build the proof screen: upload client proof PDF, status (pending/approved/rejected), approve/reject, add notes. Done when the proof is saved and status updates correctly.
tasks.done: When proof manager works end-to-end with status tracking

tasks.title: Add proof gallery per job
tasks.brief: Build the proof gallery: view all proofs per job, approve/reject per proof. Done when the gallery pulls and displays all proofs for a job and approve/reject works.
tasks.done: When proof gallery works end-to-end with per-job display

tasks.title: Add purchase order and paper stock update
tasks.brief: Build the purchase order screen: receive from supplier, update paper stock, record cost. Done when the order saves and paper stock increments correctly and low-stock alert triggers if below threshold.
tasks.done: When purchase order works end-to-end with stock update and alert

tasks.title: Add cash register with job ticket scanning
tasks.brief: Build the cash register: scan job ticket reference, record payment, print receipt with job details. Done when the sale records the job ticket and receipt prints correctly.
tasks.done: When cash register works end-to-end with job ticket scanning and receipt prints

tasks.title: Add job ticket volume per period report
tasks.brief: Build the report showing tickets created, proofing, printing, done per month. Done when the report computes from Firestore and displays correct figures.
tasks.done: When job ticket volume report computes correctly from live data

tasks.title: Add proof approval rate report
tasks.brief: Build the report showing approved vs rejected per period and reasons for rejection. Done when the report computes from Firestore and displays correct figures.
tasks.done: When proof approval rate report computes correctly from live data

tasks.title: Add paper stock turnover report
tasks.brief: Build the report showing sheets per period, low-stock alerts per period, reorder frequency. Done when the report computes from Firestore and displays correct figures.
tasks.done: When paper stock turnover report computes correctly from live data

tasks.title: Add revenue per job type report
tasks.brief: Build the report showing posters vs banners vs flyers vs invitations revenue per period. Done when the report computes from Firestore and displays correct figures.
tasks.done: When revenue per job type report computes correctly from live data

risks: Encryption key loss makes job ticket and paper records unrecoverable
WhatsApp template rejection if not approved by Meta
Proof approval without clear criteria can lead to client disputes
Paper threshold without regular reorder can halt production
